_context.preferences.language: Settings row that opens the iOS settings of the app, where its language is chosen. Its value is the current language in its own words.
_context.preferences.pushOff: Value of the Notifications row when push notifications are turned off in iOS.
_context.notifications.perCoworker.followsTasks: Value of a coworker's row: it keeps the global setting but also follows the coworker's scheduled tasks.
_context.notifications.coworker.quotedScope: Hint under the 'Your setting' option: the label of the global setting, quoted.
_context.notifications.coworker.scheduled: {count} is the number of scheduled tasks of the coworker.
_context.preferences.server: Settings row showing the self-hosted Rerun server the app is connected to.
_context.preferences.groupByBox: Option of the Coworkers picker: the Home lists the coworkers grouped by Box.
_context.notifications.channels.messages.name: Name of an Android notification channel, shown in the Android settings of the app: the pushes that ring.
_context.notifications.channels.silent.name: Name of an Android notification channel, shown in the Android settings of the app: the quiet pushes about a finished task.
